issues.description: Worst-case prep stack (POOR x RRP x cedar) = 4.40x, which exceeds the 4.0x cap guideline. This represents an extreme scenario: pre-1978 cedar fence with severe peeling requiring lead-safe containment.
issues.suggested_fix: Documented as acceptable for this extreme scenario with recommendation for T&M billing. Same pattern as SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1 where extreme prep stacks exceeded 4.0x (up to 12.32x). The 4.0x cap is a guideline, not a hard limit, for rare extreme combinations.
issues.resolution: Accepted with documentation. T&M billing recommended for this scenario.

issues.description: Recoat compatibility matrix is enforced via compatibility_rules but not as a hard engine constraint. UI must prevent incompatible selections (e.g., transparent stain over solid stain).
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure PaintScope UI disables coating_type options that are incompatible with selected substrate_state. Engine should validate at estimation time as a secondary check.
issues.resolution: Deferred to engine implementation. Compatibility rules are correctly specified.

issues.description: Chemical restoration module is largely identical to NC spec. Task IDs differ (TSK_FERP_ vs TSK_FNCE_) which prevents direct reuse but maintains RP/NC isolation.
issues.suggested_fix: No fix needed. Deliberate design choice — RP and NC task IDs must be distinct per pipeline convention. Rate values are identical to NC which is correct (same physical work).
issues.resolution: Accepted. Rate parity with NC confirmed.
